map.title: [Wayfinder Map] Candidate Pipeline Reform, Inert Prototype Guard & ADR 0064 Baseline Alignment
map.body:
## Destination

Align active Model Champion configuration (`config/model_selection.json`) with ADR 0064 empirical reality (`def_xg_shrink_challenger`), prevent Inert Prototypes from burning 1-year Dead Lever moratoriums in `smoke.py`, wire two-stage component screening (`--tier auto`: Tier 1 Minutes Gate + Tier 2 Oracle Event Gate before Tier 3 Constrained XI Gate), fix and evaluate inert mechanisms `EXT-09` and `EXT-11`, ablate the 4 `MLComponentChallengerModel` heads under the £83.5m Constrained Formation XI (Track A), and generate/execute a 38-GW Budget-Enabler & Starter Discrimination queue (Track B).

## Notes

Domain: FPL score projection math, statistical backtesting, and autonomous candidate exploration (`explore-candidate` / `ideate-candidate`).
Consult Wayfinder, antislop, domain-modeling, and grilling.
P1/P2/P3 denote priority/impact triage.
Reference evidence and step-by-step execution plan stored in `docs/research/candidate-ideation/wayfinder-implementation-plan.md`.

## Decisions so far

- **Q1 (Champion Baseline Reset)**: Revert `config/model_selection.json` `champion` to `def_xg_shrink_challenger` (with `adaptive_causal_challenger` and `club_def_prior_challenger` in `candidates`), matching ADR 0064 where `def_xg_shrink_challenger` beats `adaptive_causal_challenger` by +0.895 pts/GW on Dev 2025-26 under the £83.5m Constrained XI.
- **Q2 & Q5 (Inert Prototype Domain & Guard)**: Codified `Inert Prototype` in `CONTEXT.md`. `smoke.py` raises `InertPrototypeError` (`INERT FAIL`, exit 2) when active GWs are empty or (`max_playable_diff < 0.01` and `combined_primary_delta == 0.0`), blocking false Dead Lever entries. Reclassify `EXT-09` and `EXT-11` from `dead` to `open` in `candidate_ledger.csv` and `untested` in `idea_queue.csv`.
- **Q3 & Q6 (Staged Component Gating `--tier auto`)**: Wire `oracle_minutes: bool = False` into `backtesting/walkforward.py` (`WalkforwardConfig`) and `evaluate_oracle_event_gate` into `backtesting/promotion.py` under ADR 0064 ($L=5$ non-wrapping MBB, £83.5m Constrained XI, $P_{\text{screen}} \ge 0.65$). Add `--tier {1,2,3,auto}` to `smoke.py` so `M_mins` and `M_events` prototypes pass their isolated component screen before Tier 3 composite gating.
- **Q4 & Q7 (Track A 4-Head Ablation & Track B Budget-Enabler Ideation)**: Run a 6-variant surgical ablation of `MLComponentChallengerModel` heads (`H1`, `H3`, `H1+H3`, `H1+H3 coherent replay`, `Group B LOO assists`, `H1+H3+Group B`) against `def_xg_shrink_challenger`, then generate and run a 38-GW `--focus budget-enablers` queue on `DefXgShrinkChallengerModel`.

## Not yet specified

- Live 2026-27 GW6+ sealed holdout check (executed only once after a Candidate passes both Dev 2025-26 and Warm Conf 2024-25).

## Out of scope

- Loosening ADR 0064 promotion thresholds (Dev P >= 0.75, Conf P >= 0.65, Pooled P >= 0.85, £83.5m Constrained XI, segment floors).
- Re-running genuine Dead Levers whose mechanisms actually executed and failed (`revisit_after > today`).
- Unbanning terminal player columns or violating point-in-time feature causality.

tickets.title: [P1] Align config/model_selection.json, candidate_ledger.csv, and idea_queue.csv with ADR 0064 and Inert Prototype rules
tickets.body:
## Question

How should `config/model_selection.json`, `docs/research/candidate-ledger/candidate_ledger.csv`, `docs/research/candidate-ledger/candidate-ledger.md`, and `docs/research/candidate-ideation/idea_queue.csv` be updated so the active Model Champion matches ADR 0064 (`def_xg_shrink_challenger`) and inert prototypes (`EXT-09`, `EXT-11`) are reopened?

## Observed evidence & proposal

Under ADR 0064 (£83.5m Constrained Formation XI), `adaptive_causal_challenger` loses to `def_xg_shrink_challenger` by -0.8947 pts/GW on Dev 2025-26 (late segment -1.789 pts/GW, P = 0.122). Keeping `adaptive_causal_challenger` in `config/model_selection.json` forces every prototype into a 19-GW dormant window and causes hook collisions with `MLComponentChallengerModel`. Additionally, `EXT-09` and `EXT-11` had `combined_delta = 0.0` due to hook overwrite and the `~known & (counts > 0)` filter guard, making them Inert Prototypes rather than Dead Levers.

Proposed implementation:
1. Update `config/model_selection.json`: set `"champion": "def_xg_shrink_challenger"` and `"candidates": ["adaptive_causal_challenger", "club_def_prior_challenger"]`.
2. In `docs/research/candidate-ledger/candidate_ledger.csv` and `candidate-ledger.md`: change status of `ext_09_binomial_fixture_exposure` and `ext_11_role_*` from `dead` to `open` and clear `revisit_after` (`""`), moving them to the `## Open` section of `candidate-ledger.md`.
3. In `docs/research/candidate-ideation/idea_queue.csv`: set `status` of `EXT-09` and `EXT-11` to `untested` and clear `ledger_result`.
4. Refresh `docs/research/candidate-ideation/prototypes/README.md` to remove stale mid-run text.

## Decision acceptance

1. `load_model_selection().champion == "def_xg_shrink_challenger"`.
2. `uv run pytest tests/test_candidate_ledger.py tests/test_model_selection.py -q` passes.
3. `EXT-09` and `EXT-11` are `open` in `candidate_ledger.csv` with empty `revisit_after`.

tickets.title: [P1] Add InertPrototypeError pre-gate guard to smoke.py and unit tests
tickets.body:
## Question

How should `.agents/skills/explore-candidate/smoke.py` detect and halt an Inert Prototype before appending a false failure row to `smoke_results.csv` or `candidate_ledger.csv`?

## Observed evidence & proposal

In Batch 2, `EXT-11` skipped 100% of clubs due to `if np.any(~known & (counts > 0)): continue` (`combined_delta = 0.0, P = 0.0`), while `EXT-09` modified an inherited method that was overwritten downstream (`combined_delta = 0.0`). Both were silently recorded as valid failures and locked for 1 year.

Proposed implementation:
1. Define `class InertPrototypeError(RuntimeError): pass` and helper `check_inert_prototype(reference: WalkforwardResult, candidate: WalkforwardResult) -> None` in `.agents/skills/explore-candidate/smoke.py`.
2. Compute `active_gws = identify_active_gameweeks(reference.df_eval, candidate.df_eval)` and maximum absolute prediction difference on the Exogenous Playable Pool (`mins >= 30` or `champ_xp >= 2.0`): `max_playable_diff = max_{i,g in M} |cand_xp - champ_xp|`.
3. Raise `InertPrototypeError` if `len(active_gws) == 0` OR (`max_playable_diff < 0.01` and `abs(combined_primary_delta) < 1e-9`).
4. In `smoke.py` `main()`, catch/check `InertPrototypeError` before `append_row`, print `INERT FAIL: <name>: <reason>`, do not append to `--out`, and return exit code `2`.

## Decision acceptance

1. A clone/no-op prototype or a prototype perturbing only unplayable bench fodder by `< 0.01` pts with `0.0` regret delta triggers `INERT FAIL` (exit code 2) and writes 0 rows to `--out`.
2. A genuine prototype that alters Playable Pool projections (`>= 0.01` pts) proceeds to gate evaluation normally.
3. Unit tests in `tests/test_smoke_harness.py` verify both inert rejection cases and valid pass-through.

tickets.title: [P1] Wire Tier 1 Minutes Gate & Tier 2 Oracle Event Gate into walkforward.py, promotion.py, and smoke.py (--tier auto)
tickets.body:
## Question

How should `oracle_minutes` walk-forward conditioning, `evaluate_oracle_event_gate` (Tier 2), and `evaluate_minutes_gate` (Tier 1) be integrated into `backtesting/` and `.agents/skills/explore-candidate/smoke.py` under ADR 0064 so component prototypes are screened before Tier 3 composite gating?

## Observed evidence & proposal

Currently, `inject_oracle_minutes` and `evaluate_oracle_event_gate` exist only in `docs/research/decoupled-projection-architecture/prototype_oracle_gate.py`, and `commands/evaluate_minutes.py` uses pre-ADR 0064 bootstrap parameters. Sending every prototype directly to Tier 3 obscures whether an $M_{\text{mins}}$ or $M_{\text{events}}$ hypothesis improved its target component.

Proposed implementation:
1. In `backtesting/walkforward.py`: add `oracle_minutes: bool = False` to `WalkforwardConfig` and `inject_oracle_minutes(df_feat, df_perf, target_gw)` (natural key join on `(player_id, gameweek_id, fixture_id)`) inside `run_walkforward_backtest` prior to `model.predict()`.
2. In `backtesting/promotion.py`: promote `OracleEventGateVerdict` and `evaluate_oracle_event_gate(reference_df, candidate_df, *, target_column="blended_points", bootstrap_min_p=0.65)` using ADR 0064 £83.5m Constrained Formation XI regret, active-window isolation, non-wrapping $L=5$ MBB ($P \ge 0.65$), Exogenous Playable Pool bias tolerance ($|\text{bias}_{\text{cand}}| \le \min(|\text{bias}_{\text{champ}}| + 0.02, 0.20)$), and Captaincy Regret tolerance ($+0.15$ pts/GW).
3. In `commands/evaluate_minutes.py`: align default bootstrap block size to `BOOTSTRAP_BLOCK_GWS = 5`, active-gameweek filtering on `projected_minutes`, and `MINUTES_SCREEN_MIN_P = 0.65`.
4. In `.agents/skills/explore-candidate/smoke.py`: add `--tier {1,2,3,auto}` (default `auto` when running prototypes on `dev`; `3` on `confirm`). Support optional `COMPONENTS: dict[str, str]` in prototype modules (or infer from `idea_queue.csv` / default `all`). When `--tier auto` resolves to Tier 1 (`xp_minutes`) or Tier 2 (`xp_goals`, `xp_assists`, `xp_clean_sheet`, `xp_saves`, `xp_defcon`, `xp_bonus`), run the component gate first; if it fails, record `reasons` prefixed with `tier1_fail:` / `tier2_fail:` without running an unnecessary second walk-forward.

## Decision acceptance

1. `WalkforwardConfig(..., oracle_minutes=True)` runs cleanly with zero cross-GW leakage.
2. `evaluate_oracle_event_gate` and `evaluate_minutes_gate` use ADR 0064 $L=5$ non-wrapping MBB and active-window filtering.
3. `smoke.py --tier 1`, `--tier 2`, `--tier 3`, and `--tier auto` execute deterministically.
4. Unit tests in `tests/test_decoupled_models.py` and `tests/test_promotion.py` pass.

tickets.title: [P1] Fix and evaluate reopened prototypes EXT-09 and EXT-11 against def_xg_shrink_challenger
tickets.body:
## Question

How should `EXT-09` (`BinomialFixtureExposure`) and `EXT-11` (`OpponentRoleAllocation`) be fixed so they subclass `DefXgShrinkChallengerModel` across all 38 GWs without silent no-op guards or hook overwrites, and what are their empirical verdicts under ADR 0064?

## Observed evidence & proposal

1. `EXT-09` (`docs/research/candidate-ideation/prototypes/ext_09/prototypes.py`): Previously subclassed `AdaptiveCausalChallengerModel` (dormant GW1-19, overwritten by Head 1 in GW20+). Fix: subclass `DefXgShrinkChallengerModel` directly, activate whenever `train` has `>= _MIN_ROWS` and `fixture_count.gt(1).any()` (all GWs after first DGW, or continuous sample blend), so `_state_probabilities` directly feeds the projection pipeline.
2. `EXT-11` (`docs/research/candidate-ideation/prototypes/ext_11/prototypes.py`): Previously skipped 100% of clubs at line 219 (`if np.any(~known & (counts > 0)): continue`) because 0-minute bench players have `known = False` and positive prior `counts > 0`. Fix: subclass `DefXgShrinkChallengerModel`, restrict role reallocation within each club-fixture strictly to the subset of attackers where `known & (counts > 0)` (requiring `np.sum(known & (counts > 0)) >= 2`), preserving total expected goals across that known active subset while leaving unknown 0-minute players untouched.

## Decision acceptance

1. Both `ext_09` and `ext_11` pass `smoke.py --audit_only` and pass the new `check_inert_prototype` guard (`max_playable_diff >= 0.01`).
2. Both lanes are evaluated via `smoke.py --tier auto` against `def_xg_shrink_challenger` on Dev 2025-26.
3. Verified results are appended to `docs/research/candidate-ideation/smoke_results.csv`, `idea_queue.csv`, and `candidate_ledger.csv`.

tickets.title: [P1] Execute Track A 6-variant surgical ablation of MLComponentChallengerModel heads against def_xg_shrink_challenger
tickets.body:
## Question

Which individual or combined heads of `MLComponentChallengerModel` (`H1` `p_start`, `H3` `duration`, coherent exposure replay, `Group B` LOO assists) pass the ADR 0064 £83.5m Constrained Formation XI gate against `def_xg_shrink_challenger` once `Group A` goals inflation is isolated?

## Observed evidence & proposal

`adaptive_causal_challenger` enabled 4 heads simultaneously (`H1`, `H3`, `Group A`, `Group B`) selected under the old unconstrained XI gate. Under the £83.5m Constrained XI, it regressed by -1.789 pts/GW in `late` on Dev 2025-26. Furthermore, when `H1`/`H3` change `p_start` and `xmins_if_start`, `MLComponentChallengerModel` updates `xp_minutes` without scaling event exposures.

Proposed implementation:
Create `.tmp/agent/explore-candidate/track_a_ablation/prototypes.py` subclassing `AdaptiveCausalChallengerModel` (measured against Champion `def_xg_shrink_challenger`) with the locked 6-variant grid:
1. `track_a_h1_only`: `enable_mins_h1=True`, `enable_mins_h3=False`, `enable_goals=False`, `enable_assists=False`
2. `track_a_h3_only`: `enable_mins_h1=False`, `enable_mins_h3=True`, `enable_goals=False`, `enable_assists=False`
3. `track_a_mins_h1_h3`: `enable_mins_h1=True`, `enable_mins_h3=True`, `enable_goals=False`, `enable_assists=False`
4. `track_a_mins_h1_h3_coherent`: `enable_mins_h1=True`, `enable_mins_h3=True`, `enable_goals=False`, `enable_assists=False` + coherent event-exposure replay (`EXT-07` decoder without Group A/B)
5. `track_a_group_b_assists`: `enable_mins_h1=False`, `enable_mins_h3=False`, `enable_goals=False`, `enable_assists=True`
6. `track_a_no_goals_h1_h3_b`: `enable_mins_h1=True`, `enable_mins_h3=True`, `enable_goals=False`, `enable_assists=True`

If any variant passes Dev 2025-26 ($P \ge 0.75$, all guardrails & segment floors green), freeze as a Candidate model and evaluate once on Warm Conf 2024-25 (seed 2023-24, $P_{\text{conf}} \ge 0.65, P_{\text{pooled}} \ge 0.85$).

## Decision acceptance

1. All 6 variants pass `smoke.py --audit_only` and `check_inert_prototype`.
2. Empirical Dev results recorded in `docs/research/candidate-ideation/smoke_results.csv` and `candidate_ledger.csv`.
3. Any Dev winner is frozen and tested on Warm Confirmation per ADR 0064.

tickets.title: [P2] Generate and execute Track B 38-GW Budget-Enabler & Starter Discrimination ideation queue
tickets.body:
## Question

How should `ideate-candidate` be updated and invoked to generate 38-GW candidate hypotheses targeting £4.0m–£5.5m budget-enabler discrimination on `DefXgShrinkChallengerModel`?

## Observed evidence & proposal

In `candidate_ledger.csv`, 0 levers have been tried in the `Budget & Valuation` subsystem, even though the £83.5m Constrained Legal Formation XI forces 4–6 budget starters into every optimal lineup. Meanwhile, `.agents/skills/ideate-candidate/generate_prompt.py` and `ingest_ideas.py` currently scaffold `AdaptiveCausalChallengerModel` (GW20+ only) by default.

Proposed implementation:
1. Update `.agents/skills/ideate-candidate/generate_prompt.py` and `ingest_ideas.py` so default code skeletons and hooks target `DefXgShrinkChallengerModel` across all 38 Gameweeks (with continuous $N_{\text{eff}}$ or Empirical Bayes shrinkage) and include a `### 3. Decoupled Architecture Placement` field that `ingest_ideas.py` maps to `component` for `smoke.py --tier auto`.
2. Run `uv run python .agents/skills/ideate-candidate/generate_prompt.py --focus budget-enablers` to refresh `docs/research/candidate-ideation/candidate_model_ideation_prompt.md`.
3. Run full test and verification gates (`uv run ruff check .`, `uv run pytest`, `bash tests/verify.sh`).

## Decision acceptance

1. `generate_prompt.py` and `ingest_ideas.py` reflect `def_xg_shrink_challenger` as active Champion and scaffold `DefXgShrinkChallengerModel` subclasses.
2. `candidate_model_ideation_prompt.md` is regenerated with accurate Ledger counts and `def_xg_shrink_challenger` baseline context.
3. All unit tests, `ruff check .`, and `bash tests/verify.sh` pass with 0 errors.
